snippet.title: Marble It Up: Mayhem! - Apple Arcade Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The joy of rolling is back! Marble It Up: Mayhem! is the newest chapter in marble platforming - fresh from the minds behind Marble It Up! and Marble Blast. World-class level design, buttery-smooth controls, and brand-new multiplayer - welcome to the beginning of the best marble experience yet!

App Store: https://apple.co/-MarbleMayhem

Embrace the intuitive and chaotic multiplayer modes. Hunt gems, tag your friends, and prove your marble mettle online. Blast your way to glory!

Roll through a beautifully designed single-player campaign filled to the brim with dangerous obstacles, mind-bending paths, shifting gravity, and potent power-ups.

Grow your magnificent collection of marbles and trails. Find hidden trophies, complete chapters, earn medals, and play online - all while rolling towards your next unlock.

Push yourself to the next level. Global and friend leaderboards, replays, and ghost races are all part of a master marbler’s toolkit!

Sign up for the newsletter at https://www.marbleitup.com
Follow us on twitter at https://twitter.com/MarbleItUp
